_readme.title: Vayu + VIB Integrator Roadmap
_readme.source: Roadmap supplied by the user for website synchronization.
_readme.status_policy: Statuses reflect the supplied roadmap. Do not mark implementation complete without repository and test evidence.

phase_status.next: Immediate next work; not yet marked complete.
phase_status.planned: Planned; not started or not verified.
phase_status.deferred: Intentionally deferred; gated until prerequisites and direction allow it.

_readme.notes: Phase 0, Phase 1, and VIR foundation Phase 2 are complete. Phase 3 is next. --native at this stage means Integrator-mediated VIR execution, not native machine code; NativeCodegen remains Scaffolded. .vye packaging and backend dispatch/cache work remain deferred.

phases.name: Baseline and subsystem ownership
phases.description: Establish a reproducible clean-build baseline, assign subsystem ownership, and define capability reporting before expanding implementation.

subphases.name: Record the VS Community clean-build and clean-test baseline (Rebuild → Build → run_all.ps1); make no assumptions about existing state.
Codify subsystem ownership.
subphases.description: Output: vib::Feature enum covering all four routes and every language feature.

subphases.name: Make the capability matrix the single source of truth.
subphases.description: Output: Static CapabilityInfo table in VIB/Integrator.cpp.

subphases.name: Curate fixtures and stable expected outputs.
subphases.description: Output: Fixture list embedded in tests/vib_baseline.ps1.

phases.name: Integrator API and CLI routing
phases.description: Centralize capability metadata and route native-path behavior and diagnostics through the Integrator.

subphases.name: Expand the Integrator API.
subphases.description: Output: Feature, SupportLevel, ErrorKind, Backend, CapabilityInfo, extended CompileResult, and static queries.

subphases.name: Make NativeCompiler a pure adapter.
subphases.description: Output: No hardcoded messages outside VIB/.

subphases.name: Add --vib-status and unify error routing.
subphases.description: Output: New CLI flag; four native-path flags route through Integrator.

subphases.name: Establish the Phase 0/1 test harness.

phases.name: VIB internal representation (VIR)
phases.description: Build a verified in-memory VIR pipeline. This phase does not introduce .vye packaging or artifact caching.

subphases.name: Implement VIR data structures.
subphases.description: Output: VIB/Vir.hpp: VirType, VirValue, VirOpcode, VirInstruction, VirBlock, VirFunction, VirModule.

subphases.name: Implement the VIR printer.
subphases.description: Output: VirPrinter::print produces human-readable module text.

subphases.name: Implement structural VIR verification.
subphases.description: Output: VirVerifier::verify validates functions, blocks, indices, and terminators.

subphases.name: Implement minimal lowering for PassStmt and empty programs.
subphases.description: Output: VirLowering::lower; every non-Pass statement returns a planned Phase N diagnostic.

subphases.name: Integrate VIR with Integrator::dumpIR and the driver.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::VIR = Supported; Feature::Verifier = Supported; --dump-ir prints VIR on success.

subphases.name: Add VIR test coverage.
subphases.description: Output: tests/vib_baseline.ps1 verifies --dump-ir succeeds on pass-only programs and fails cleanly on non-trivial programs.

phases.name: Basic arithmetic and values
phases.description: Define deterministic value semantics, lower the first executable subset to VIR, and execute it through the Integrator rather than claiming machine-code generation.

subphases.name: Specify integer, boolean, and None semantics, including overflow, conversion, division by zero, and comparison.
subphases.description: Output: Semantics in code comments and tests; Feature::BasicArithmetic = Supported (pending).

subphases.name: Lower integer/boolean expressions and local variables into VIR; extend VirOpcode with ConstInt, Add, Sub, Mul, Div, Cmp*, and Move.
subphases.description: Output: --dump-ir succeeds on an arithmetic-only program.

subphases.name: Implement an in-memory VIR interpreter; --native becomes Integrator-mediated execution. NativeCodegen remains Scaffolded.
Extend the verifier with type consistency, arity checks, and CFG well-formedness.

phases.name: String semantics and operations
phases.description: Define deterministic string behavior and lower string operations into VIR.

subphases.name: Specify UTF-8 policy, representation, equality, concatenation, length, and index bounds.
Lower string constants and operations into VIR.

phases.name: Functions and calls
phases.description: Implement calls and scopes with explicit safety rules.

subphases.name: Implement functions, parameters, return values, local scopes, direct calls, and arity/type checks in VIR.
Add recursion only after stack-frame safety is proven.

phases.name: Control flow and branch verification
phases.description: Add structured control flow and reject invalid branch structures.

subphases.name: Implement conditional branches, loops, return, break, and continue in VIR.
Validate branch targets and emit unreachable-code diagnostics in the verifier.

phases.name: Collections
phases.description: Add collections individually with explicit representation, mutation, iteration, and ownership semantics.

subphases.name: Implement list representation, indexing, mutation, iteration, and ownership in VIR.
Add map, tuple, and set, each gated by conformance tests.
Implement module identity, import resolution, and dependency validation in VIR.
Build multi-file programs reproducibly from declared inputs.

phases.name: VIR robustness and runtime compatibility
phases.description: Harden malformed-input handling and define runtime compatibility in code.

subphases.name: Test malformed VIR, including huge counts, invalid indices, truncated structures, and stack exhaustion.
Document runtime-compatibility policy in code (no .md) and report it through --vib-status --json.

phases.name: Advanced language features and system APIs
phases.description: Expand the Integrator subset in independently tested feature groups.

subphases.name: Implement exceptions, classes/objects, closures, higher-order functions, generators, and pointers, with separate tests for each group.
subphases.description: Output: Each feature flips individually in --vib-status.

subphases.name: Implement system APIs and standard-library surface relevant to the Integrator subset.
subphases.description: Output: Parity versus Interpreter for the supported subset.

phases.name: VYE container design and writer
phases.description: Deferred package-format work. Do not implement the writer before its gate after Phase 10.

subphases.name: Design-only .vye container specification. Code comments and API shape only; no writer.
Implement a deterministic .vye writer gated by --emit-vye <path>.

phases.name: VYE reader and execution
phases.description: Deferred until package format design and writer gates are authorized.

subphases.name: Implement a strict .vye reader and verifier.
Add the vayu run <file>.vye execution verb.
subphases.description: Output: Round-trip and execution tests green.

phases.name: Unified backend dispatch and caching
phases.description: Deferred until current execution behavior is stabilized and dispatch/cache scope is authorized.

subphases.name: Make Integrator the dispatch owner for the Interpreter backend without changing behavior.
Make Integrator the dispatch owner for the VM backend without changing behavior.
Add a content-addressed, atomic artifact cache and incremental graph.

phases.name: Benchmarks and performance tuning
phases.description: Measure behavior before optimizing; avoid unsupported performance claims.

subphases.name: Measure compile time, startup, steady-state execution, memory, and package size separately.
Tune performance based on measurements only.

phases.name: Native code generation
phases.description: Research native code generation on top of verified VIR; keep target and ABI rules in Vayu-owned code.

subphases.name: Research native code generation on top of VIR; do not bundle LLD, DLLs, import libraries, or an external backend.
subphases.description: Output: Native artifacts pass conformance per supported target.

subphases.name: Report NativeCodegen = Supported only for proven targets.

phases.name: Vayu-owned ONNX support
phases.description: Implement an ONNX reader and tested operator subset without a Python generator.

subphases.name: Implement a Vayu-owned ONNX parser/reader with native fixtures; no Python generator.
Implement a small operator subset first and expand through tests.

phases.name: Runtime capability reporting and self-hosting
phases.description: Expose machine-readable support status and attempt self-hosting only after the subset stabilizes.

subphases.name: Publish the supported feature/runtime-version matrix through --vib-status --json.
Start the self-hosting bootstrap loop only after the Integrator subset is stable.
